senses: man, male (in contrast to woman, female)
human being, person (in contrast to God)

strongs.def: a man as an individual or a male person; often used as an adjunct to a more definite term (and in such cases frequently not expressed in translation)
strongs.kjv: also, another, any (man), a certain, [phrase] champion, consent, each, every (one), fellow, (foot-, husband-) man, (good-, great, mighty) man, he, high (degree), him (that is), husband, man(-kind), [phrase] none, one, people, person, [phrase] steward, what (man) soever, whoso(-ever), worthy. Compare H802 (אִשָּׁה)
strongs.from: contracted for H582 (אֱנוֹשׁ) (or perhaps rather from an unused root meaning to be extant)
